remaining_work: Retain the explicitly requested independent keyboard application alongside the original Plasma Keyboard. The remaining delta is the configurable laptop keyboard/touchpad surface, physical sizing, language and toolbar policy, and same-RPM native KWin routing/refresh integration. These are application/compositor policies, not hardware protocols suitable for kernel/DT or a separate bridge RPM. Propose compatible changes upstream and retire the application only after equivalent original-package features, settings, DNF ownership and rollback are qualified. Release32 passes native software checks; physical input, lock, refresh restoration, native30-60 VRR and future-image acceptance remain open.
